reviewNotes: HOLD — UNIDES's official 2026 fee table lists a six-year Medicina y Cirugía course in Managua, with annual registration of C$6,411.00 and a daytime monthly payment of C$9,158.00. A December 2025 UNIDES notice says fifth-year students who completed five years of theoretical-practical preparation would start hospital rotational internship in 2026. The record supports the programme, duration, domestic fee schedule and internship progression, but no official international admissions route, language-of-instruction statement, recognition/licensing evidence for the intended audience, or international accommodation/support terms were found. This is not publish-ready as a study-abroad medical option.
